# Player runs a session

## Summary

Player starts and logs a session.

## Situation

Player is on the dashboard with a program picked.

## Behavior

The session runs drill by drill.

## Constraints

- A session has at least one drill.

## Children

- [Starts from dashboard](./starts-from-dashboard/) — Player opens a session from the dashboard. (stale)
- [Logs the last drill](./logs-last-drill/) — Player logs the final drill. (done)

## Open questions
